name: update_packages
title: Update packages that are missing or out-of-date.

origin.description: Update packages that are missing or behind the repository. An empty character vector installs nothing.
origin.usage: update_packages(packages = TRUE, dependencies = NA, upgrade = c("default", "ask", "always", "never"), force = FALSE, quiet = FALSE, repos = getOption("repos"), type = getOption("pkgType"), ...)

arguments.name: packages
arguments.text: TRUE updates installed packages. character() installs nothing. A name updates that package.

arguments.name: upgrade
arguments.text: never installs only a package that is not installed. A current package is left alone.

arguments.name: force
arguments.text: Deprecated. TRUE warns and has no effect.
Further arguments are passed to install.packages. lib is the library directory and is accepted.

origin.details: upgrade = never does not upgrade remotes when that package is already installed on the library path. lib is only the destination if an install is required. The return value is invisible NULL.
origin.example: update_packages("remotes", lib = lib, quiet = TRUE, upgrade = "never")

translation.description: Update packages that are missing or behind the repository.
translation.usage: update_packages(packages=True, dependencies=NA, upgrade='default', force=False, quiet=False, repos=None, type=None, lib=None)

arguments.name: packages
arguments.text: True lists installed names. An empty list installs nothing. A string is one package name.

arguments.name: upgrade
arguments.text: never keeps only packages whose status is not installed.
Further arguments are passed to install.packages. lib is the library directory and is accepted.

translation.details: The installed copy is found on the session library path, which includes ~/R/library for reading. The call does not install into that directory. A current package returns None and leaves lib empty.
